categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, extents, ownership details, and land use conditions. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land registration and property ownership matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
